sum: The Joint Corp. operates and is a franchisor and operator of chiropractic clinics in the United States. The company provides services under the franchise agreement, including training of franchisees and staff, site selection, construction/vendor management and ongoing operations support. It operates through a network of franchised clinics, offering routine and affordable chiropractic adjustments using a private pay, non-insurance, cash-based model. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona.
